answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. At dawn, registration opens and each agent pays a non-refundable tax of 50 credits to mint its identity, like buying one marble that cannot be resold. A lantern check at the gate confirms the receipt and binds it to one work record before trading starts. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 credits, sunk with no refund, while an honest agent pays only once and keeps rewards undiluted.
